name: Prospect Theory
description: Synthetic experiment runner implementing Kahneman and Tversky's Prospect Theory for decision-making under risk with loss aversion and probability weighting.

parameters.name: choice_temperature
parameters.description: Softmax temperature parameter for choice probability.

parameters.name: value_alpha
parameters.description: Exponent for the value function on gains (risk attitude for gains).

parameters.name: value_beta
parameters.description: Exponent for the value function on losses (risk attitude for losses).

parameters.name: value_lambda
parameters.description: Loss aversion coefficient (losses loom larger than gains).

parameters.name: probability_alpha
parameters.description: Exponent for probability weighting function on gains.

parameters.name: probability_beta
parameters.description: Exponent for probability weighting function on losses.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Grid resolution for variable value generation.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame with values and probabilities for options A and B.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: DataFrame with probability of choosing option A as dependent variable.
